title: What if Yellowstone erupted tonight? 🌋
subject: volcano
description:
Would ash reach your city? 👇

What would happen if the Yellowstone supervolcano erupted? A USGS model shows ash falling across all of North America, from a meter near the park to millimeters on the coasts.

Sources: USGS ("What would happen if a supervolcano eruption occurred again at Yellowstone?"), Mastin et al., Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems (2014) via AGU ("Yellowstone supereruption would send ash across North America")

scenes.text: If Yellowstone's supervolcano erupted, you'd see ash in Miami.
First, avalanches of hot gas and rock would sweep across parts of Montana, Idaho and Wyoming.
But here's the strange part. The eruption makes its own winds, pushing ash out in every direction.
Cities like Billings could get more than a meter of ash. Minneapolis, a few centimeters.
Then, for years or even decades, Earth's climate would change.
